title: 12. Động từ nguyên mẫu có to

intro.text: Bài 12 — Động từ nguyên mẫu có to (To-infinitive). Học theo thứ tự: đọc kỹ 📚 Kiến thức đầy đủ → làm câu hỏi từng phần → mở đáp án. Cuối bài có Mini Test 16 câu.
Trọng tâm TOEIC: Part 5/6 — chọn 'to + V' sau động từ/tính từ/danh từ nhất định, chỉ mục đích; phân biệt với V-ing (Bài 13–14) và nguyên thể không 'to' sau modal/make/let.

knowledge.text: Động từ nguyên mẫu có 'to' (to-infinitive = to + V nguyên thể) có thể làm chủ ngữ, tân ngữ, bổ ngữ, chỉ mục đích, hoặc đi sau nhiều động từ, tính từ và danh từ. Đây là cấu trúc cốt lõi, thường đối lập với danh động từ (V-ing) ở Bài 13–14.
2. Chỉ mục đích (= in order to / so as to)

to + V diễn tả mục đích 'để…', tương đương 'in order to' / 'so as to'. Có thể đứng đầu câu kèm dấu phẩy: To cut costs, we changed suppliers. KHÔNG dùng 'for + V nguyên thể' để chỉ mục đích (sai 'for cut costs'); 'for' chỉ đi với danh từ/V-ing.

want, need, decide, plan, hope, expect, agree, refuse, offer, promise, manage, fail, afford, learn, prepare, intend, tend, arrange, aim, choose, would like + to V. Ví dụ: The board decided to expand. We hope to hear from you.
4. Động từ + tân ngữ + to V

want / ask / tell / advise / allow / encourage / expect / invite / remind / warn / enable / require / permit / force / cause + somebody + to V. Ví dụ: The manager asked the team to work overtime. The policy requires employees to wear badges.

Nhiều tính từ đi với to V: easy, difficult, hard, happy, glad, pleased, ready, able, willing, eager, likely, reluctant, proud + to V. Cấu trúc phổ biến: It is + adj + to V (It is important to confirm early). The software is easy to use.
decision, plan, ability, chance, opportunity, way, time, effort, right, permission, need, attempt, failure + to V. Ví dụ: They made a decision to invest. She has the ability to solve problems.

rows: too heavy to lift (quá nặng không nhấc nổi)
enough staff to finish on time

items: Sau động từ khuyết thiếu (modal): will, can, could, may, must, should, would + V (không 'to'): must follow.
make / let / have + somebody + V (bare): The manager made the team work late. The CEO let the intern leave early.
help + (to) V: cả 'help to do' và 'help do' đều đúng.
would rather / had better + V (bare): You had better confirm now.

knowledge.text: (1) Chỉ mục đích dùng 'to V' / 'in order to', KHÔNG 'for + V'. (2) Nhiều động từ buộc 'to V' (decide/agree/refuse/manage to do) — đừng dùng V-ing. (3) require/ask/advise/allow + sb + to V. (4) Sau modal và make/let dùng nguyên thể KHÔNG 'to' (must follow, let him go). (5) too + adj + to V (quá… không thể) ≠ adj + enough + to V (đủ… để).

questions.q:
The board decided ___ the budget for next year.
A. increase    B. to increase    C. increasing    D. increased
questions.a: Đáp án: B (to increase). ||decide + to V.

questions.q:
We hope ___ from you soon.
A. hearing    B. to hear    C. hear    D. heard
questions.a: Đáp án: B (to hear). ||hope + to V.

questions.q:
The supplier agreed ___ the delivery date.
A. to move    B. moving    C. move    D. moved
questions.a: Đáp án: A (to move). ||agree + to V.

questions.q:
Management plans ___ a new branch in Da Nang.
A. opening    B. to open    C. open    D. opens
questions.a: Đáp án: B (to open). ||plan + to V.

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"She refused signing the revised contract."
questions.a: Lỗi: "refused signing" → "refused to sign". ||refuse + to V.

questions.q:
The new hire managed ___ the project on time.
A. complete    B. to complete    C. completing    D. completed
questions.a: Đáp án: B (to complete). ||manage to V = xoay xở làm được.

questions.q:
Chọn câu ĐÚNG:
A. We expect receiving the goods Friday.
B. We expect to receive the goods on Friday.
C. We expect receive the goods on Friday.
D. We expecting to receive the goods on Friday.
questions.a: Đáp án: B. ||expect + to V.

questions.q:
Điền vào email (Part 6):
"Our team aims ___ customer satisfaction this quarter."
A. improving    B. to improve    C. improve    D. improved
questions.a: Đáp án: B (to improve). ||aim + to V.

parts.heading: Phần 2 · Động từ + tân ngữ + to V

questions.q:
The manager asked the team ___ overtime this week.
A. work    B. to work    C. working    D. worked
questions.a: Đáp án: B (to work). ||ask + somebody + to V.

questions.q:
The policy requires all employees ___ ID badges.
A. wear    B. to wear    C. wearing    D. worn
questions.a: Đáp án: B (to wear). ||require + sb + to V.

questions.q:
We encourage customers ___ feedback through the app.
A. to provide    B. providing    C. provide    D. provided
questions.a: Đáp án: A (to provide). ||encourage + sb + to V.

questions.q:
The supervisor reminded us ___ the report by noon.
A. submitting    B. to submit    C. submit    D. submitted
questions.a: Đáp án: B (to submit). ||remind + sb + to V.

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"The trainer advised them practicing daily."
questions.a: Lỗi: "advised them practicing" → "advised them to practice". ||advise + sb + to V.

questions.q:
HR invited all staff ___ the workshop on Friday.
A. attend    B. to attend    C. attending    D. attended
questions.a: Đáp án: B (to attend). ||invite + sb + to V.

questions.q:
Chọn câu ĐÚNG:
A. The rule allows visitors to park here.
B. The rule allows visitors park here.
C. The rule allows visitors parking here.
D. The rule allows visitors parked here.
questions.a: Đáp án: A. ||allow + sb + to V.

questions.q:
Điền vào email (Part 6):
"The new system enables managers ___ data in real time."
A. to track    B. tracking    C. track    D. tracked
questions.a: Đáp án: A (to track). ||enable + sb + to V.

parts.heading: Phần 3 · Chỉ mục đích, tính từ & danh từ + to V

questions.q:
He arrived early ___ the venue before the guests.
A. to check    B. checking    C. for check    D. check
questions.a: Đáp án: A (to check). ||to V chỉ mục đích.

questions.q:
___ reduce costs, the firm switched suppliers.
A. To    B. For    C. So    D. Because
questions.a: Đáp án: A (To). ||To + V đầu câu = mục đích (= In order to).

questions.q:
This accounting software is easy ___.
A. to use    B. using    C. use    D. used
questions.a: Đáp án: A (to use). ||tính từ (easy) + to V.

questions.q:
We are pleased ___ you to our team.
A. to welcome    B. welcoming    C. welcome    D. welcomed
questions.a: Đáp án: A (to welcome). ||pleased + to V.

questions.q:
The company made a decision ___ in renewable energy.
A. to invest    B. investing    C. invest    D. invested
questions.a: Đáp án: A (to invest). ||danh từ (decision) + to V.

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"She has the ability solve complex problems."
questions.a: Lỗi: "ability solve" → "ability to solve". ||danh từ (ability) + to V.

questions.q:
Chọn câu ĐÚNG:
A. He stayed late for finish the report.
B. He stayed late to finish the report.
C. He stayed late for finish report.
D. He stayed late finish the report.
questions.a: Đáp án: B. ||mục đích dùng to V, không 'for + V'.

questions.q:
Điền vào thông báo (Part 6):
"Employees are encouraged to take short breaks ___ stay productive."
A. to    B. for    C. so    D. because
questions.a: Đáp án: A (to). ||to V chỉ mục đích (= in order to).

parts.heading: Phần 4 · too…to / enough…to & nguyên thể không to

questions.q:
The instructions were ___ complicated to follow.
A. too    B. enough    C. very much    D. as
questions.a: Đáp án: A (too). ||too + adj + to V = quá… không thể.

questions.q:
She is experienced ___ to lead the team.
A. enough    B. too    C. very    D. so
questions.a: Đáp án: A (enough). ||adj + enough + to V = đủ… để.

questions.q:
The report was clear ___ for everyone to understand.
A. enough    B. too    C. so    D. very
questions.a: Đáp án: A (enough). ||adj + enough (+ for sb) + to V.

questions.q:
All staff must ___ the safety guidelines.
A. follow    B. to follow    C. following    D. follows
questions.a: Đáp án: A (follow). ||sau modal (must) dùng nguyên thể KHÔNG 'to'.

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"The manager let the intern to leave early."
questions.a: Lỗi: "let the intern to leave" → "let the intern leave". ||let + sb + V (bare).

questions.q:
The supervisor made the team ___ overtime to meet the deadline.
A. work    B. to work    C. working    D. worked
questions.a: Đáp án: A (work). ||make + sb + V (bare).

questions.q:
Chọn câu ĐÚNG:
A. The box was too heavy to lift.
B. The box was too heavy for lift.
C. The box was enough heavy to lift.
D. The box was so heavy to lift.
questions.a: Đáp án: A. ||too + adj + to V; 'enough' đứng SAU tính từ.

questions.q:
Điền vào mô tả (Part 6):
"The conference hall is large ___ to host 500 guests."
A. enough    B. too    C. so    D. very
questions.a: Đáp án: A (enough). ||adj + enough + to V.

questions.q:
We plan ___ the office to a larger building next month.
A. to relocate    B. relocating    C. relocate    D. relocated
questions.a: Đáp án: A (to relocate). ||plan + to V.

questions.q:
The client asked us ___ the quotation.
A. to revise    B. revising    C. revise    D. revised
questions.a: Đáp án: A (to revise). ||ask + sb + to V.

questions.q:
___ avoid delays, please confirm your order early.
A. To    B. For    C. So    D. Because
questions.a: Đáp án: A (To). ||to V chỉ mục đích.

questions.q:
The old machine is ___ slow to handle current demand.
A. too    B. enough    C. very much    D. as
questions.a: Đáp án: A (too). ||too + adj + to V.

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"They decided postponing the product launch."
questions.a: Lỗi: "decided postponing" → "decided to postpone". ||decide + to V.

questions.q:
All managers are required ___ the compliance training.
A. to complete    B. completing    C. complete    D. completed
questions.a: Đáp án: A (to complete). ||require + sb + to V (bị động: be required to V).

questions.q:
This printer is reliable ___ to handle high print volume.
A. enough    B. too    C. so    D. very
questions.a: Đáp án: A (enough). ||adj + enough + to V.

questions.q:
The supervisor had the technician ___ the device.
A. inspect    B. to inspect    C. inspecting    D. inspected
questions.a: Đáp án: A (inspect). ||have + sb + V (bare).

questions.q:
Chọn câu ĐÚNG:
A. She wants that you call her.
B. She wants you to call her.
C. She wants you call her.
D. She wants calling you.
questions.a: Đáp án: B. ||want + sb + to V.

questions.q:
Điền vào email (Part 6):
"We are happy ___ that the partnership has been finalized."
A. to announce    B. announcing    C. announce    D. announced
questions.a: Đáp án: A (to announce). ||happy + to V.

minitest.heading: 🏋️ Bài luyện tập tổng hợp (Mini Test · 16 câu)
minitest.note: Làm liên tục 16 câu, gợi ý 8–10 phút, KHÔNG mở đáp án giữa chừng. Mục tiêu: đúng từ 13/16 trở lên.

questions.q:
The committee agreed ___ the proposal.
A. to approve    B. approving    C. approve    D. approved
questions.a: A (to approve). ||agree + to V.

questions.q:
The manager asked the assistant ___ the documents.
A. to prepare    B. preparing    C. prepare    D. prepared
questions.a: A (to prepare). ||ask + sb + to V.

questions.q:
___ improve efficiency, the company upgraded its software.
A. To    B. For    C. So    D. Because
questions.a: A (To). ||to V chỉ mục đích.

questions.q:
The crate is ___ heavy to carry alone.
A. too    B. enough    C. very much    D. as
questions.a: A (too). ||too + adj + to V.

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"He hopes joining the marketing team."
questions.a: Lỗi: "hopes joining" → "hopes to join". ||hope + to V.

questions.q:
The policy requires staff ___ all visitors at reception.
A. to register    B. registering    C. register    D. registered
questions.a: A (to register). ||require + sb + to V.

questions.q:
This user guide is simple ___.
A. to follow    B. following    C. follow    D. followed
questions.a: A (to follow). ||tính từ (simple) + to V.

questions.q:
The CEO let the team ___ the final decision.
A. make    B. to make    C. making    D. made
questions.a: A (make). ||let + sb + V (bare).

questions.q:
Chọn câu ĐÚNG:
A. We expect to finish by Friday.
B. We expect finish by Friday.
C. We expecting to finish by Friday.
D. We expects to finish by Friday.
questions.a: A. ||expect + to V.

questions.q:
The firm plans ___ overseas next year.
A. to expand    B. expanding    C. expand    D. expanded
questions.a: A (to expand). ||plan + to V.

questions.q:
Employees are encouraged ___ ideas at the meeting.
A. to share    B. sharing    C. share    D. shared
questions.a: A (to share). ||encourage + sb + to V (bị động: be encouraged to V).

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"The trainer made us to repeat the task."
questions.a: Lỗi: "made us to repeat" → "made us repeat". ||make + sb + V (bare).

questions.q:
She is qualified ___ to manage the entire department.
A. enough    B. too    C. so    D. very
questions.a: A (enough). ||adj + enough + to V.

questions.q:
___ ensure quality, each item is inspected twice.
A. To    B. For    C. So    D. Because
questions.a: A (To). ||to V chỉ mục đích.

questions.q:
The supplier promised ___ the goods on time.
A. to deliver    B. delivering    C. deliver    D. delivered
questions.a: A (to deliver). ||promise + to V.

questions.q:
Điền vào báo cáo (Part 6):
"Our goal is ___ response time to under one hour."
A. to reduce    B. reducing    C. reduce    D. reduced
questions.a: A (to reduce). ||to V làm bổ ngữ cho 'goal is…'.

summary: to + V làm chủ ngữ/tân ngữ/bổ ngữ, chỉ mục đích, và đi sau nhiều động từ, tính từ, danh từ.
Mục đích: to V / in order to / so as to (KHÔNG 'for + V').
Động từ + to V: decide, agree, plan, hope, manage, refuse… ; Động từ + sb + to V: ask, require, advise, encourage, allow, enable…
too + adj + to V (quá… không thể) ≠ adj + enough + to V (đủ… để).
Nguyên thể KHÔNG 'to' sau modal (must do) và sau make/let/have + sb + V.

summary_callouts.text: Bẫy lớn nhất: phân biệt 'to V' với 'V-ing' (Bài 13–14). Sau giới từ và một số động từ (enjoy, avoid, suggest…) phải dùng V-ing, KHÔNG dùng to V.
Sau khi làm xong: nếu đúng dưới 13/16, đổi Trạng thái bài thành "Cần ôn" và xem lại danh sách động từ + to V sau 1 ngày.
